items.topic: EIP-8130 的扩展与 Base 的承诺
items.title: 新 EIP：无状态账户
items.note: （chunter-cb）提交，Magicians 讨论帖 18:41。依赖 8130，定义 `account_changes` 类型 `0x03`：只在本交易内存在的账户，带 8130 创建时的 `initial_actors` 数组和仅本交易有效的 7702 委托，不写 Keystore。同一机制两种用法，唯一盐值为一次性账户，复用同一参数并提交配置变更则为长期账户。
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), submitted, with a Magicians thread at 18:41. It requires 8130 and defines `account_changes` type `0x03`: a transaction-scoped account with 8130 create's `initial_actors` array, a 7702 delegation for this transaction only, and no Keystore write. One mechanism has two uses: a unique salt gives an ephemeral account, and reusing the same parameters with a config change gives a long-lived one.

items.topic: EIP-8130 的扩展与 Base 的承诺
items.title: 新 EIP：执行交易的 Keystore 签名
items.note: （chunter-cb）提交。让 EIP-2930 和 EIP-1559 交易通过 Keystore 认证，而不是把 secp256k1 `ecrecover` 当作权威；65 字节签名仍走 k1 默认 EOA 路径，其他签名格式为 `account || authenticator || data`，因此这些交易类型可以使用后量子和可聚合签名。
items.title_en: New EIP: Keystore signatures for execution transactions
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), submitted. It authenticates EIP-2930 and EIP-1559 transactions through the Keystore instead of treating secp256k1 `ecrecover` as the authority; 65-byte signatures stay on the k1 default-EOA path, and any other signature is `account || authenticator || data`, so those transaction types can be post-quantum and aggregatable.

items.topic: 规范冲突与 slot 时间
items.title: EIP-8250：把 TXPARAM_LEGACY_NONCE 移出 0x0C
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）提交。EIP-8141 已把 `TXPARAM` 索引 `0x0C` 分给 `state_gas_left`，同时启用两者的链上会冲突，PR 把它移到空闲的 `0x11`。同作者提交 EIP-8272：把 RECENTROOTREFLOAD 移出 0xB5。
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil), submitted. EIP-8141 already assigns `TXPARAM` index `0x0C` to `state_gas_left`, so a chain enabling both would have two claims on one index; the PR moves it to the free `0x11`. The same author submitted EIP-8272: move RECENTROOTREFLOAD off 0xB5.

summary_en: jessepollak announced that Base will roll out EIP-8130 native accounts and wants to work with Ethereum and other EVM teams to do the same; the same day chunter-cb submitted three EIPs built on 8130: stateless accounts, a transaction events view, and Keystore authentication for EIP-2930/1559 transactions, which would let those transactions use post-quantum and aggregatable signatures. Barnabé submitted a PR retargeting EIP-8198 to 10-second slots. PRs for EIP-8250 and EIP-8272 moved numbers that clashed with 8141. StarkWare said a Falcon-512 account transacted on Starknet mainnet for $0.06.
